oracleAuthorship: Source-first authoring from complete existing local guide records and reviewed knowledge witnesses before execution of this fresh suite. No runtime reply was used to select expected claims or sources.
validationScope: 32 turns in eight four-turn dialogues: 12 answerable and four unsupported boundaries per game (24 answerable, eight boundaries total). Exact source tuples, full required useful claims and literal sourceWitness values. fullFieldValues preserves bindings and qualifications; proofFields identifies exact original child fields when the cited source record groups multiple fields. allSources requires every listed response citation. No fact IDs are used. External-research claims remain limited to the locally reviewed 2026-10-24 records, with no current upstream verification.
